title: Dow Jones Industrial Average in Turmoil, Here's How RealMoney's Traders Are Positioning
text:
The stock market is all over the place, and being positioned correctly is paramount.
TheStreet has leading columnists on RealMoney that are analyzing the markets and suggesting some top trades. Is it time to buy Apple ( AAPL ) on this market rout? Should you wade into once red-hot Dow component Boeing ( BA ) at this precise moment? Is the S&P 500 on the verge of losing another 5% inside of two days?
How is markets legend and TheStreet founder Jim Cramer thinking through this volatility? You need to know these things people! The market has taken a punch to the face, and making money like everyone did in January won't be so easy this month.
The RealMoney team has you covered. Here are several top reads from the team today.
